faqs.q: Can I visit just to look and ask questions?
faqs.a: Please do. Plenty of people come in three or four times before they decide anything. There is no pressure to buy on the day, and we would rather you left with a plan than with an animal you were not ready for.

faqs.q: Can you hold an animal while I finish the enclosure?
faqs.a: Ask us and we will usually arrange something. We are also happy to look the setup over before the animal moves in.

faqs.q: What does a custom enclosure cost and how long does it take?
faqs.a: It depends on size, materials and the heating you need. Send your measurements and the species on WhatsApp and we will quote you.
Message us about supplies and enclosures around Klerksdorp. Livestock we prefer you collect, so we can hand over in person and go through the care details with you.

faqs.q: Are your reptiles and exotics legally sourced?
faqs.a: Yes. If a species needs a permit on your side, we will tell you before you buy rather than after.

faqs.q: My setup already has problems. Can you help?
faqs.a: Send a photo of the enclosure and its readings on WhatsApp. Heat, humidity and lighting issues usually show up straight away, and the fix is normally cheaper than people fear.

hero.subtitle: A small pet shop run by Juanita and Gert. Hand-reared birds, responsibly sourced reptiles and exotics, planted aquariums, and enclosures we build ourselves. Ask us anything before you buy.

livestock.title: Meet the residents
livestock.intro: We keep a small selection so every animal is properly housed and properly known before it goes home. What we have changes from week to week, so message us and we'll tell you what is here today.

habitats.title: Enclosures built to fit your animal and your room
habitats.intro: Off-the-shelf cages rarely suit either. Gert builds timber vivarium cabinets, aviaries and small-mammal enclosures to your measurements, with the ventilation, heating runs and access panels planned in from the start.

supplies.title: Feeders, food and hardware
supplies.intro: Live feeders, species-appropriate dry food, and the Akwa range for tanks, filtration and water chemistry. If we don't stock something, we'll point you to someone who does.

care.title: We would rather talk you out of it than sell you the wrong pet
care.intro: Most exotics that struggle are in the wrong setup rather than the wrong hands. Tell us about your room, your budget and your week, and we'll match an animal to it honestly, including when the answer is "not yet".

visit.title: Come and meet them in person
visit.intro: We're inside Eden Garden Centre. There's parking, and the coffee shop is right there if you want to think it over.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.subtitle: Tell us about your space and how much time you have. We'll come back with two or three options, and what each one actually costs to keep.

footer.blurb: Ethical exotic pets, custom-built habitats and Akwa aquatics, run by Juanita and Gert in Klerksdorp.

stock.title: Chinchilla
stock.description: Soft, inquisitive and handleable. Eating their complete pellet mix reliably. Sold as a bonded pair or individually.

stock.title: Sugar Glider
stock.description: Hand-raised joeys, used to being held. We will walk you through their diet, bonding pouch and nocturnal schedule.

stock.title: Cockatiel
stock.description: Step-up trained and vocalising. Several colour mutations in stock. Raised by hand from hatch.

stock.title: Lovebird
stock.description: Young birds, tame and eating a varied seed and veggie mix. Great starter parrot.

stock.title: Sun Conure
stock.description: Loud, playful and brilliantly coloured. These are fully weaned and step up without hesitation.

stock.title: Bearded Dragon
stock.description: Captive-bred juveniles, feeding on crickets and greens. Handleable, bright-eyed and alert.

stock.title: Leopard Gecko
stock.description: Feeding on mealworms and crickets. Calm, easy to handle and a great first reptile.

stock.title: Blue-Tongue Skink
stock.description: Captive-bred, eating fruit, veggie and protein mix. Chunky, docile and surprisingly interactive.

stock.title: Ball Python
stock.description: Established feeder on frozen-thawed mice. Calm temperament, ideal beginner snake.

stock.title: Leopard Tortoise
stock.description: South African species, permit available on your side. We will talk you through the process and the outdoor setup.

stock.title: Hermann's Tortoise
stock.description: European species, captive-bred with CITES paperwork. Currently out of stock — enquire to be notified.

stock.title: Freshwater Tropicals
stock.description: A rotating selection of hardy community fish from the Akwa range. Ask us what is in the tanks this week.

stock.title: Planted Aquarium Setup
stock.tag: Tank + filter + plants · Ready to go
stock.description: Starter planted setups: tank, filter, substrate and a selection of easy plants. Cycled and ready for fish.

stock.title: Custom Vivarium Cabinet
stock.description: Quote based on your species, dimensions and heating. Gert builds them in-house. WhatsApp your measurements.

stock.title: Custom Aviary / Flight Cage
stock.description: Designed for the species and the space. Indoor and outdoor options. Ask for a quote.
